title: Cryptomorphism: valuated quotients as functions on rank-k flats (Prop. essential-relations)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
The entire construction of the involution rests on the asserted but unstated
**Proposition (prop:essential-relations)**: a corank/rank-$k$ valuated matroid quotient
$\theta$ of the trivial valuation on $M$ is equivalent data to a function on the
**rank-$k$ flats** of $M$ satisfying a specific finite list of *essential* relations.

What must be proved:
1. The correct indexing of the rank-$k$ Plücker coordinates of a quotient by rank-$k$ flats of $M$
   (matroid analog of: Plücker coordinates of $[W]\in\Gr(k,\mathbb{F}^r)$ ↔ $k$-dim coordinate subspaces).
2. An **explicit** statement of the essential tropical Plücker / incidence–Plücker relations on these
   flat-indexed coordinates (the problem never writes them down).
3. A proof that this essential system is **equivalent** to the full tropical Plücker + incidence
   system restricted to quotients of the trivial valuation on $M$, i.e. that all non-essential
   relations are implied.

Without (1)–(3) the definition $\theta'(F):=\theta(F^\perp)$ is not even type-correct.
This is the deepest gap and is exactly the content deferred to \cite{wang26modular}.

Tropical Plücker relations are indexed by $(S,T)$ with $|S|=k-1$, $|T|=k+1$ and require
$\min_{a\in T\setminus S}\{\mu(T-a)+\mu(S+a)\}$ to attain its min twice. Recasting these on
rank-$k$ flats should use modular pairs of flats of ranks $k-1$ and $k+1$; the essential relations
are presumably the 3-term relations from such modular pairs. Prove redundancy of the rest via an
exchange / local-to-global argument on the geometric lattice.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
## Resolution of prob-08-2: cryptomorphism via explicit essential relations

I rewrote the solution to address items (1)-(3). New material: **Section "The cryptomorphism: essential relations"** (Def. `essential`, Prop. `essential-relations`, Lemmas `E2-incidence`, `incid-plucker`); `prop:wd`/`prop:rev` are re-proved on this basis. The previous proofs reduced to an asserted "valuated-duality + relabel" compatibility, which is NOT rigorous: the matroid dual `M*` is a different matroid (confirmed: Fano* has rank 4 != 3) and `\perp` is an involution of `L(M)`, not a map `L(M*)->L(M)`.

**(1) Indexing.** Constancy on flats gives a bijection {corank-(r-k) quotients theta of trivial M} <-> {flat-constant functions w}, theta(B)=w(cl_M B). So rank-k Plücker coords of a quotient are indexed by rank-k flats. This makes theta'(F):=theta(F^\perp) type-correct (both sides functions on flats of complementary rank, matched by \perp: L_{r-k}->L_k).

**(2) Explicit essential relations.** w: L_k(M)->Rbar is a flat-coordinate of a quotient iff (E1) supp w is the rank-k level of a matroid quotient of M, and (E2) for every interval [A,Z] of L(M) with rk A=k-1, rk Z=k+1, the min of w(F) over rank-k flats F with A<F<Z vanishes tropically. These (E2) are the 3-term tropical Plücker relations on modular pairs of flats of ranks k-1, k+1 — as the issue anticipated.

**(3) Equivalence / redundancy.** lem:E2-incidence: (E2) <=> theta_w satisfies elementary incidence with trivial M (modular interval = flat-translate of the incidence relation). lem:incid-plucker: for flat-constant theta, incidence with trivial M already implies full tropical Plücker (relative local-to-global / exchange argument; higher Plücker and incidence-for-m<r reduce to chains of 3-term modular relations). prop:wd, prop:rev then reduce to the purely lattice-theoretic fact that the essential relations are \perp-invariant: \perp sends [A',Z'] (ranks r-k∓1) to [Z'^\perp,A'^\perp] (ranks k∓1), At(.)->At(.) bijectively, w^\perp(F')=w(F'^\perp), so the value-multiset and (E2) are preserved. This is exactly why \perp is needed and why no duality is expected without it.

**Numerical verification (workspace scripts):**
- Cryptomorphism (E1,E2) <=> quotient: agreement on ALL 16383 functions for Fano F7 (rank 1 & 2).
- \perp maps ALL 171 valuated quotients of trivial F7 to valid quotients (both rank directions), preserving essential relations.
- lem:incid-plucker (incidence => Plücker for flat-constant theta): ZERO counterexamples for F7, U_{2,4..6}, U_{3,5}, and the non-modular graphic matroid M(K4) — evidence it is matroid-general.
- Scope finding: U_{4,6} has NO order-reversing involution (6 atoms vs 20 rank-3 flats), hence out of scope; my first naive "A subset Z" relation guess failed only on such mis-indexed cases, which led to the correct modular-interval form (E2).

**Honest residue (=> in_progress, not resolved).** Two steps are given as local-to-global/exchange arguments backed by exhaustive computer checks but not spelled out to the last index: (a) lem:incid-plucker case (ii), rewriting a (t+2)-term Plücker relation as a chain of 2-term modular relations along a maximal chain of the geometric lattice; (b) the (E1)-clause of prop:wd, that "flat-lattice of a quotient of M" is a \perp-self-dual condition (meet-closed coideal <-> join-closed ideal). Both are lattice-intrinsic, verified numerically, and are the technical content the problem attributes to the companion work. With these, the construction is type-correct and the involution is well-defined/order-reversing on explicit footing.
